provenance: Synthetic fixtures authored for Lokad.qpdf. Linearized fixtures are deterministic oracle outputs recorded for offline checking. MIT with the repository.
generation: Deterministic classic-xref PDFs with LF endings, Helvetica text, ordered objects and computed xref offsets. Truncated fixture is the first 120 bytes of minimal-1page.pdf.

fixtures.description: One page, classic xref, unencrypted. Oracle --check and --show-npages must succeed; independent reader must report 1 page.
Two pages sharing one font, classic xref, unencrypted. Oracle and independent page counts must agree on 2.

One page with /Rotate 90, classic xref, unencrypted. Rotation flattening must drop /Rotate, swap the media box, and wrap content with the 90-degree counter-transform; the rotation differential consumes it.

One page with an unreferenced /F2 Helvetica-Bold font alongside the used /F1, classic xref, unencrypted. Resource pruning under page operations must drop /F2 while whole-file output keeps it; the prune differential consumes it.
One page whose catalog carries /StructTreeRoot and /MarkInfo, classic xref, unencrypted. Structure removal must drop both keys while keeping the pages tree; the removal differential consumes it.

One page with a self-contained text widget (stale appearance, NeedAppearances). Oracle and independent page counts must agree on 1; appearance generation and annotation flattening differentials consume it.

Two pages each carrying a self-contained text widget (NeedAppearances, document default resources). Subset selection must prune the unselected field while full selection and merge keep both registrations; the forms-preserve differential consumes it.
Two pages sharing one font with document outlines, classic xref, unencrypted. Linearized selection must carry the outline tree into the output hint tables.
Two outlined pages with PageMode UseOutlines, classic xref, unencrypted. Linearized selection must place outlines in the first-page part.
One page with a thumbnail image XObject, classic xref, unencrypted. Linearized selection must place the thumbnail in part 9.
One page linearized by the pinned oracle with static IDs. Oracle check must succeed; managed linearization check must pass.
Two pages linearized by the pinned oracle with static IDs. Oracle and managed linearization checks must agree.

One page linearized by the pinned oracle with static IDs and generated object streams (xref streams plus an object stream). Managed linearization inspection must pass without dedicated container handling.

Two pages linearized by the pinned oracle with static IDs and generated object streams (xref streams plus an object stream). Managed linearization inspection must pass without dedicated container handling.

One page with a direct image XObject and a form XObject holding a nested image. --show-pages --with-images must list only the direct image with dimensions; the form and its nested image stay unlisted.
One page with a dimension-less image XObject. --show-pages --with-images must list 0 x 0 dimensions with per-key warnings (exit 3 on both sides).

One page with four image XObjects: Flate with decode parms, undecodable DCT (filterable is support-based), chained ASCIIHex+Flate, and Indexed. --json must report filter names, aligned parms, and level-gated filterable flags; the json-images differential consumes it.

One page with trailer /Info (Title, ModDate) and catalog /Metadata XMP stream, classic xref, unencrypted. --remove-info must drop metadata and non-ModDate info keys while --remove-metadata drops only the stream; the metadata differential consumes it.
Negative fixture: truncated input. Both oracle --check and the independent reader must fail explicitly; a passing validation is a test failure.

One page with a 1500-byte inline image above the default externalization threshold, classic xref, unencrypted. Inline-image externalization and threshold selection must convert it to an /IIm1 XObject on both sides; the inline differential consumes it.

One page with /Rotate 90, direct /UserUnit and a widget carrying an appearance stream, classic xref, unencrypted. Rotation flattening must rotate the appearance matrix and keep the user unit on both sides; the flatten-rotation differential consumes it.

One page with an orphan dictionary, an orphan stream, a dangling page and linked catalog metadata, classic xref, unencrypted. Object preservation must keep all four loose payloads with metadata linked on both sides; the preserve-unreferenced differential consumes it.

One page with a large noisy RGB photo above the optimization thresholds, classic xref, unencrypted. Image optimization must emit smaller DCT streams with identical dimensions on both sides; the optimize differential consumes it.
